async function outer_break(pages, rows, save, load, cursor, nextCursor, last) {
	for (const page of pages) {
		await load();
		for (const row of rows) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await save(row);
		}
		if (last) break;
	}
}

async function outer_return(pages, rows, save, load, cursor, nextCursor, last) {
	for (const page of pages) {
		await load();
		for (const row of rows) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await save(row);
		}
		if (last) return;
	}
}

async function outer_sleep(pages, rows, save, load, cursor, nextCursor, last) {
	for (const page of pages) {
		await load();
		for (const row of rows) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await save(row);
		}
		await sleep(1);
	}
}

async function outer_condition(
	pages,
	rows,
	save,
	load,
	cursor,
	nextCursor,
	last,
) {
	while (cursor != null) {
		await load();
		for (const row of rows) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await save(row);
		}
		cursor = nextCursor;
	}
}

async function outer_true(pages, rows, save, load, cursor, nextCursor, last) {
	while (true) {
		await load();
		for (const row of rows) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await save(row);
		}
	}
}

async function outer_stream(pages, rows, save, load, cursor, nextCursor, last) {
	for await (const page of pages) {
		await load();
		for (const row of rows) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await save(row);
		}
	}
}
